findings.evidence: `rg "det_standardOrthogonal|standardOrthogonalGroupEquiv.*det"` finds no declaration; the sole compatibility result is `det_orthogonalGroupContinuousEquivMatrix` at `Topology/Algebra/QuadraticForm/OrthogonalGroup/Matrix.lean:104`, under topological hypotheses.
findings.fix: Add an algebraic theorem identifying `(standardOrthogonalGroupEquiv h2 g : Matrix n n R).det` with `QuadraticMap.orthogonalDet _ g`, and derive the continuous comparison’s determinant theorem from it.
findings.issue: `standardOrthogonalGroupEquiv` has no determinant lemma, despite this module’s API claiming determinant preservation, so algebraic consumers cannot rewrite its determinant without importing topology and adding `TopologicalSpace`/`IsTopologicalRing` instances.

summary: The algebraic standard-form equivalence lacks its determinant characterization; the only exported result unnecessarily requires topology.
